summary.headline: Daesung Hi-Tech signs KRW 22.5bn chip test-parts equipment supply deal with China's Jiangsu Hanchuang
summary.what_happened: On Nov 24, 2026, Daesung Hi-Tech Co., Ltd. signed a single supply contract with JIANGSU HANCHUANG MACHINERY CO., LTD for equipment used to manufacture parts for semiconductor back-end testing, with 100% of the deal being exports to China. The contract period runs from Nov 24, 2026 to Aug 31, 2028, and includes an advance payment of CNY 9,000,000 due Nov 30, 2026.
summary.why_it_matters: Large supply contracts disclosed under Korean exchange rules typically indicate a company's order backlog and the scale of a deal relative to its recent sales, which investors often use to gauge near-term business activity. The filing also notes that the KRW amount is converted at the Nov 24, 2026 exchange rate and that the price may be renegotiated if the KRW/CNY rate moves more than ±10%.
